about: The router's phrase set (ADR-013, ADR-068, ADR-019 layer 6, S7.1 to S7.4, T11.1): 20 phrasings for each of the six requests, across kinds and with collisions between kinds, 10 sentences with make's or change's words that aren't a build (the collide set), and 20 sentences that can't be routed. A case's set is its id before the number. A slot an expectation leaves out isn't scored; a list is the answers that count; what is the words a make's or a change's what must hold. No streaming service is named: Kino stands in for one the box's agent built. Blocks, Family Quiz and Bus Times are apps the agent made, for change.
